title: Resolved Images of the Protoplanetary Disk around HD 100546 with ALMA
question: What are the resolved morphology, size and kinematics of the dust (870 um) and CO(3-2) gas in the HD 100546 disk, and what do they imply for planet-related processes?

data.angular_resolution: 0.93" x 0.37" (PA=39 deg) continuum; 0.92" x 0.38" (PA=38 deg) CO
data.sensitivity: continuum rms 5.7 mJy/beam; CO rms 27 mJy/beam per channel

evidence.quote: it is not possible to constrain $R_{\rm in}$, and therefore it is fixed at 14 au (cite: quanz2011)

what.value: Gas surface density Sigma_gas(r)=18 (r/au) g cm-2

recipe.method: Uniform weighting imaging in CASA; uvcontsub and multiscale clean for CO
Elliptical Gaussian fit to visibilities; inclination from axis ratio

recipe.goal: Fit truncated uniform disk to visibilities
recipe.method: Truncated disk of uniform surface brightness fit to de-projected visibilities; free F0 and Rout
MCMax model with 1-3 mm grain component truncated at Rout in a grid 40-100 au in 10 au steps
key_parameters: mm dust mass 5e-4 Msun, 0.1x hydrostatic scale height

recipe.goal: CO moments and PV diagram kinematics
recipe.method: Moment maps and major-axis PV diagram compared with Keplerian curves for M*=2.4 Msun at 40 and 30 deg
key_parameters: moment 0 over -2.1 to 14.0 km/s; moment 1 voxels >3 rms, pixels with integrated intensity >0.4 Jy/beam km/s

recipe.method: St = sqrt(2 pi) rho_s a / Sigma_gas at 50 au

evidence.quote: The total and peak flux are 1.09 Jy and 0.500 Jy beam$^{-1}$, respectively.
The PA of the major axis (145.14$\ensuremath{^\circ}$$\pm$0.04$\ensuremath{^\circ}$) and inclination angle (41.94$\ensuremath{^\circ}$$\pm$0.03$\ensuremath{^\circ}$), are in agreement
the total flux is 1.07$\pm$0.02 Jy and the outer radius is 45.8$\pm$0.7 au
The CO (3–2) emission extends out to 3.5$\ensuremath{''}$ (340 au), where the 3-$\sigma$ level is reached
For separations $<$2$\ensuremath{''}$ the velocities are better reproduced with an inclination angle of 30$\ensuremath{^\circ}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges for continuum and uvcontsub
Clean masks, thresholds, cell and image size
Details of the truncated-disk visibility fit (binning, weights, fitting method)
Exact modifications to the Mulders et al. 2011 model and goodness-of-fit criterion
Phase-center and de-projection details for the visibility plots
missing_for_reproduction: Fitting procedure details for the truncated disk
score_reason: Public data and standard CASA steps with many numeric results, but imaging and model-fit details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data; uvmodelfit and visibility results are numeric and redoable, though imaging details are missing.
